question: Where is the nearest fast food restaurant as you travel in the direction of Asbury Barn Recreation Center, Erie, PA from Main Street Art, Girard, PA?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Main Street Art%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Girard%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%PA%' LIMIT 1 ), end_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Asbury Barn Recreation Center%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Erie%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%PA%' LIMIT 1 ), target_bearing AS ( SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(s.geometry, e.geometry)) AS bearing FROM start_point s, end_point e ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois p, start_point sp, target_bearing tb WHERE p.amenity = 'fast_food' AND LEAST( ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(sp.geometry, p.geometry)) - tb.bearing), 360 - ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(sp.geometry, p.geometry)) - tb.bearing) ) <= 45 -- Filter for POIs within a 90-degree cone (45 degrees on either side) of the target bearing ORDER BY ST_Distance(sp.geometry::geography, p.geometry::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;
